name: JoSAA: IITs, NITs, IIITs and GFTIs
DASA and CIWG (NRI, OCI, foreign; CIWG for Gulf)
SRMJEEE: other campuses (Ramapuram, Vadapalani, NCR and others)
KEAM (Kerala): engineering
note: Aggregate of Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics; SC/ST/SEBC/PwD 40% (OEC follows SEBC). Rank list: 50% normalised KEAM score and 50% normalised Class 12 marks (Maths, Physics and Chemistry at 5:3:2); minimum KEAM score 10 of 300 (SC/ST exempt). Age 17 by 31 December 2026.

name: MHT-CET (Maharashtra): B.E./B.Tech through CAP
note: Open candidates 45%; EWS and reserved categories 40% (the brochure words the 40% for Maharashtra State candidates). A CET score, or JEE Main for All India candidates, is also needed. Merit is the CET score; Class 12 marks are used for the cut-off and as tie-breakers.

name: AP EAPCET (Andhra Pradesh): engineering
note: Maths, Physics and Chemistry together: 45% General, 40% reserved. Rank: 75% EAPCET normalised marks and 25% Intermediate marks (the normalisation procedure was under review). EAPCET qualifying mark 25% (none for SC/ST). Local/non-local rules follow a state order for 2026-27 that was not available.

name: GGSIPU (Delhi): B.Tech through JEE Main
note: 55% aggregate in PCM, each subject passed, plus English. Reserved-category relaxation is "as per University policy" and no figure is stated, so the General figure is used for every category. Delhi Region 85% and outside Delhi 15%, by the place of Class 12 school.

name: DTU and NSUT (Delhi): B.Tech through JAC Delhi
note: 60% in PCM; SC/ST 50%, OBC-NCL 55%, PwD 50%, Defence 55%; no relaxation for EWS. JAC Delhi, not JoSAA; 85% Delhi and 15% outside Delhi by place of Class 12 school. IIIT-Delhi asks 70% in the best five subjects including PCM and 70% in Maths (OBC-NCL and PwD 65%, SC/ST 60%).
